Row-level differences for one table

Source: R/dolt-history.R
dolt_table_diff.Rd

Wraps DoltLite's per-table `dolt_diff_<table>` relation. Columns come in `from_`/`to_` pairs plus commit metadata and a `diff_type`.

Usage

dolt_table_diff(con, table, from = NULL, to = NULL, range = NULL)

Arguments

con

a `DoltliteConnection`.

table

the table name.

from, to

endpoints: a branch, tag, commit hash, `HEAD~1`, `WORKING`, and so on. Give both for a two-point diff. Give neither to get the table's whole per-commit row history.

range

alternatively a range string: `"main..feature"` for the two endpoints, or `"main...feature"` for merge-base to right endpoint.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

con <- DBI::dbConnect(doltliter::Doltlite(), tempfile())
dolt_config(con, user.name = "Ada", user.email = "ada@example.com")
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "t", data.frame(id = 1:2, v = c(10, 20)))
dolt_commit(con, "init")
DBI::dbExecute(con, "UPDATE t SET v = 99 WHERE id = 1")
#> [1] 1
dolt_table_diff(con, "t", from = "HEAD", to = "WORKING")$diff_type
#> [1] "modified"
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
